詞曲 / Redo Daeng Badji
中文翻譯 台北真道教會

lines.b: You became flesh to show Your love

lines.a: 奇妙主 榮耀神 何等的偉大
lines.b: Amazing Lord, glory to God, how great You are
You surpass all the name of earth

lines.a: 為我罪流寶血 贖回我生命
lines.b: For my sins You bled for me, to save my life

lines.a: 無人能與祢相比 祢掌權直到永遠
lines.b: No one compares to You, You rule for eternity
I will raise my voice to praise You

lines.a: 喔 何等偉大的愛 高過諸天深海
lines.b: Oh, how great is Your love, greater than the sky and sea
You deserve such a praise, Oh

lines.a: 喔 主祢滿有能力 世界盼望是祢
lines.b: Oh, Lord You are full of power, You are the hope of the world

lines.a: 我要敬拜祢 耶穌我的主
lines.b: I will worship You, Jesus, my Lord
